analysis.effect_estimator: equal-family mean of paired binary strict-success differences

minimum_detectable_effect_disclosure.method: normal-approximation planning scenarios for 60 paired clusters; not achieved power

native_tools.description: minimal native Ollama tool loop over Brick typed contracts

sharvin_balanced_adapter.description: pinned Sharvin balanced orchestration over the same Brick typed executor and state

execution.analysis_embargo: no score, grade, strict-success, family result, or aggregate is displayed until all 120 cells have a validated terminal disposition
execution.compatibility_opening: six separately labeled instrument-only cells use excluded ordinal 3 (one paired context per family), run before the final panel, are never graded or analyzed, and automatic continuation requires a score-free valid gate seal
execution.terminal_policy: all 120 logical cells must be complete and instrument-valid; no partial analysis, substitution, adaptive extension, or extra seed

opportunity_budget.deviation_from_sharvin_default: Sharvin's executable balanced profile defaults to 20 calls; this resource-constrained supported configuration uses the immutable Brick task envelope of 18 calls for paired comparability

panel.prior_exposure: all candidate contexts had condition outcomes under the earlier Qwen study before this protocol; no result or grade is an input to the selector

selection.method: lexicographically minimum SHA-256 canonical ordinal subset among all subsets satisfying exact half-panel margins; largest-remainder policy targets with lower policy index tie-break

limitations: This is a system-level contrast: native Ollama function calling versus prompted JSON Sharvin orchestration; scaffolding and tool-call transport differ together.

The treatment is a pinned Sharvin balanced orchestration adapter over Brick's typed executor, task world, office renderer, evidence store, and strict graders; it is not the byte-exact full persistent product.
The three families were chosen using earlier Qwen calibration and may not be mid-difficulty for Llama 3.1 8B.
Candidate contexts had prior Qwen outcome exposure, although the mechanical selector consumes no result or grade.
All selected instances begin with empty memory and require no saved memory, so persistent-memory product value is not tested.
Sharvin's default 20-call profile is run under the fixed 18-call Brick task budget for arm parity.
The same synthetic contexts and strict graders support controlled local-system validation, not independent production or external-account validation.
mandatory_metrics: paired equal-family effect and 95 percent interval
model calls and generated-token exact-or-bound totals
never_claim: external Gmail Outlook Teams or MCP validation
harness-only causal effect separated from tool-call transport
general superiority outside this fixed three-family local panel

sampling.condition_order: within each family rank selected instances by SHA-256 of protocol digest plus family plus instance id; first 10 AB and last 10 BA
sampling.seed: low 63 bits of SHA-256 over brick.llama8.product-validation.seed/1, protocol digest, instance id, model digest; identical across conditions
